q: the horses that pant as they gallop
(into the thick of battle during Jihaad)!
By the sparks that fly from the striking of their hooves
v.s: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
v.c: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺,

q: (attack with their Mu'min masters on the Kuffaar enemies)
penetrating the midst of the enemy's ranks
(because of their loyalty to their masters).
v.s: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
v.c: and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines!

q: is extremely ungrateful to his Rabb.

(Whereas these horses are prepared to give up their lives for their masters because of the care they receive, man refuses to obey Allaah's commands even though Allaah has created him and provides everything he needs.)
v.s: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
v.c: Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—

q: (Far from being ignorant of his ungrateful behaviour)
v.s: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
v.c: and they certainly attest to this—

q: (one of the prime causes of this behaviour is that)
(and is oblivious of Allaah because of his obsession to acquire wealth).
v.s: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
v.c: and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains.

q: Is he not aware of the time when whatever lies within the graves shall be raised
v.s: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
v.c: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out,

q: within the chests will be exposed
v.s: And that within the breasts is obtained,
v.c: and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—

q: their Rabb shall certainly be Informed about them.
(If man keeps the Day of Qiyaamah in mind, his love for this world will diminish and he will devote his loyalty to Allaah just as the horses do in Jihaad.)
v.s: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
v.c: surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day.
